headline: Turkish Airlines Posts $1.3 Billion Net Income in Third Quarter
summary: Turkish Airlines reported higher third-quarter revenue, though profitability was constrained by sharply higher fuel expenses and overall cost inflation.
why: Airlines are highly sensitive to jet fuel price volatility and macroeconomic cost inflation impacting operational margins.

impacts.name: Turkish Airlines
impacts.why: Higher fuel costs and inflation directly impact airline operating earnings and financial results.
